people.imagined: Over the marsh at dawn, on the back of her crane king. She has just let out a great laugh at something below that carries across the reeds. Wind pulls down from her braid.
people.subject: The moment: riding high on the back of a huge grey-and-white crane king above a misty marsh, she throws back her head in a big carrying laugh and then looks straight at the viewer, wind whipping her. Face: wiry, weathered and tanned, high cheekbones; deep laugh lines; a wide mouth open in a laugh showing strong teeth; bright narrow dark eyes; straight dark brows; a small windburn patch on each cheek. A small old scar nicks the left eyebrow, and her ears are pink with cold. Hair: a long black braid with a few silver threads thrown over one shoulder, tied at its end with a strip of blue silk, with four separate tufts of white crane down caught along it, clearly visible; a small silver crane crown sits at her crown. Body: lean and tough, relaxed in the saddle. Clothing: the head's richest dress: layered grey and white silk with three crossed collars embroidered with flying silver cranes, wide sleeves streaming back, and a long mantle of white crane down brocaded in silver thread that billows behind her; a jade-and-silver sash. Hands and objects: one hand grips a rein of plaited silk cord; at her belt hangs a small round bronze bell on a jade tassel, shining, in clear view. Power: a strong swirl of green-white wind and soft wood-green motes spirals around the mantle and the crane's wings, as if the air itself obeyed her. Background: a dark-blue dawn sky of drifting mist, silver marsh far below, the crane's grey neck and black-tipped wing at the frame edge. Light: silvery spirit-light with a gold rim light from the upper left on her wind-wet cheek. Expression: joyful, loud, kind; delight and wind-bright tears at the corners of her eyes.

people.imagined: On the winter terrace in a gale, he squints into the wind looking for a Wind-born child among the camp. The cloak snaps behind him. He knows he was a week too late once and will not be again.
people.subject: The moment: standing on an exposed winter terrace in a gale, he squints hard into the wind with narrowed eyes and looks at the viewer without speaking, searching for a Wind-born child among the camp. Face: a lean, hard, wind-cut face of brown leather; deep creases from the eye corners; a long straight nose; cracked lips pressed closed; short grey stubble at the chin; dark eyes squeezed almost shut; a narrow scar on the forehead. Hair: dark brown going grey, tied in a high knot by a worn but fine silver band across the brow, grey hairs at the temples, a pale crane feather behind one ear. Body: wide-shouldered, solid, braced against the wind. Clothing: the dress of an elder: a heavy mantle of white crane down quilted in diamond rows over layered grey and white silk, its high collar of yellowed down turned up round the jaw, a silver crane embroidered on the crossed collar beneath, wide sleeves held shut at the chest; a plain bone toggle fastens the mantle. Hands and objects: both hands, in grey silk gloves with a long mended split in the right, hold the mantle closed. Power: faint dusty-gold motes and thin threads of wind whip around him and stream past the terrace edge, steady as a trained wind. Background: a pale grey sky of racing mist, bare brown rock and a distant tilted line of mine head-frames, streaks of wind-blown dust glowing faintly. Light: cold silver spirit-light from the upper left with a pale rim along the cheek and down-edge. Expression: silent, stubborn, searching; he looks at the viewer as at a stranger who may or may not have wind in his bones.

people.imagined: In the reeds at dawn, standing knee-deep, a fluffy crane chick clamped under her arm, counting the old cranes in her head. She looks up slowly.
people.subject: The moment: standing knee-deep in still marsh water at dawn, with a fluffy ash-grey crane chick tucked under one arm, she lifts her slow gaze toward the viewer, counting the old cranes in her head. Face: broad, round and calm; weathered pink-brown skin; wide-set soft brown eyes with deep creases; a broad flat nose; a full gentle mouth; a few grey hairs at the brow; thin reed-cut scratches on her cheek. Hair: black streaked with grey, in a thick low braid wound around her head and pinned with a jade hairpin shaped like a reed, a few wet strands clinging to her cheek. Body: slow, broad and heavy, wide shoulders, steady. Clothing: clean reed-green silk with a crossed collar and wide sleeves pushed up, the hem tied up to the knee and dark with water; over it a pale-gold cape of woven reed silk tied in neat rows with green cord; the plain outer-gate grey sash at the waist, simple and graceful. Hands and objects: her left arm holds the rounded chick with oversized feet against her side; her right hand, marked with fine red reed cuts, rests on its back. Power: a faint pale blue-green glow of water and wood qi rings her ankles and ripples out across the water, stronger than her quiet manner suggests. Background: blurred green reeds, silver water, a distant row of tall pale cranes in rising mist. Light: soft moonlit mist with a silvery rim light on her broad cheek. Expression: patient, motherly, sad; her slowness is not dullness, and the deep eyes seem to count something very sad.

people.imagined: Landing at a vassal's gate on a windy afternoon. He has been drinking with the envoy and starts talking before his feet touch down. The jade tallies clink in his satchel.
people.subject: The moment: just landed from the air, he leans toward the viewer with a wide chatty grin, flushed and mid-sentence, one arm flung out, having drunk with the envoy and started talking before his feet touched the ground. Face: a round, cheerful, ruddy face with flushed cheeks, a broad mouth in a gap-toothed grin, bright brown eyes squeezed by smile lines, thick untidy brows and a short stubbly chin. Hair: brown and windswept, tied back loosely with a green silk cord through which a grey-and-white crane feather is stuck. Body: sturdy and loose-limbed, rocking forward on his toes. Clothing: graceful grey and white silk with an open crossed collar embroidered with silver flying cranes, wide sleeves flung back, and a short mantle of white combed crane down over one shoulder; across his back a satchel of pale silk closed with a small brass buckle, and a loop of small plain green jade tally tokens, unmarked, hanging clearly from the strap. Hands and objects: one hand swings a small round wine gourd by its cord; the other arm is flung out as he talks. Power: a faint warm earth-gold shimmer and a few drifting feathers of light curl in the wind around him, the trace of a rider who has just come down from the sky. Background: blurred gate towers with fluttering pale banners in the mist, a crane's wing at the frame edge. Light: glowing golden spirit-light from the upper left with a soft rim along the cheek. Expression: a merry, slightly tipsy grin with bright, unfocused eyes, the face of a man who has told everyone everything except what he carries.

people.imagined: Below a vast cliff, in a long wait for a roc. She narrows one eye at the ledge far above, one hand wedged in a bucket of goat. She has no doubt it will let her near.
people.subject: The moment: standing under a high cliff, she looks up at a ledge with one eye squeezed narrow, then turns the same hard look on the viewer, one hand wedged in a bucket of raw goat meat; she has no doubt the roc will let her near. Face: a sharp, lean, weathered face; copper-brown skin; high cheekbones; a strong hooked nose; one eye narrowed hard and the other wide open and dark; thick straight brows; a thin mouth set in ambition. A small scar crosses her chin, and a vertical line between her brows deepens when she glares upward. Hair: black, in a tight single braid wrapped around the head and held by a silver pin, coarse pale-brown goat hair stuck to it. Body: tall, hard and wiry. Clothing: close-fitting grey silk with crossed collars embroidered in silver cranes, a down-edged riding mantle with a dust-stained hem, the wide sleeves bound at the wrist with silver-studded guards and both sleeves covered in coarse pale-brown goat hair, plainly visible. Hands and objects: one hand rests on the rim of a wooden bucket of raw meat; the other points one finger up toward the unseen cliff. Power: a faint grey-gold shimmer of dust and wind qi gathers around her raised hand and lifts the loose hairs of her braid. Background: a blurred towering rust-brown cliff face wreathed in mist, a huge nest of sticks on a distant ledge, white-streaked rock, a huge shadow passing overhead. Light: hard silver spirit-light from the upper left with deep cliff shade behind and a thin rim along the jaw. Expression: ambitious, fearless, cold.

people.imagined: At dawn on the feeding platform, she has just given her crane today's new name and sulks that nobody used it. A feather braided in her hair; scars up both arms.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a feeding platform at dawn she thrusts out her chin and glares at the viewer in a mock sulk, then a smile breaks through; she has just given her crane today's new name and nobody used it. Face: a small, sharp, freckled face with a tilted nose; tanned cheeks; bright green-flecked hazel eyes with pale lashes; short thick brows; full lips pulled into a pout; a smear of fish scale shining on her cheek. Hair: auburn-brown, in a single braid with one long grey-and-white crane feather woven into it, hanging in front of the shoulder. Body: small, wiry, fidgety. Clothing: simple graceful grey silk with a modest crossed collar and a thin silver crane at the hem, the wide sleeves pushed up to the elbow; both forearms are covered in white hawk-claw scars, a dozen thin parallel lines each, bright against the tan; a short cloak of white crane down, tousled from flying; wrist guards of pale leather painted with small feathers. Hands and objects: her two hands hold a bucket of silver fish against her chest. Power: none beyond a faint warm-gold shimmer of motes in the air at her feet. Background: a blurred pale platform rail floating in a rose-and-grey misty sky, a tall grey bird's head in the corner. Light: soft pink dawn spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle golden rim. Expression: sulky, proud, quick to joy; the sulk is half a game, and the real feeling underneath is happiness she cannot contain.

people.imagined: Mid-yawn at the dawn feed, leaning on a bucket and half asleep. He has long since given up wanting to ride.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the feed trough before the sun is fully up, he yawns widely with one hand half raised, rubbing an eye, half asleep at the dawn feed and long since reconciled to never riding. Face: a round, soft-cheeked, smooth young face with fair skin; sleepy heavy-lidded brown eyes, one squeezed shut in the yawn; thick dark brows; a wide yawning mouth; chapped lips; a faint sleep crease on one cheek and a little drool at the chin. Hair: black, tousled and flat on one side from the pillow, with a cowlick at the crown, tied loosely with a plain green ribbon. Body: soft, loose and a little round-shouldered. Clothing: clean reed-green silk of a groom, a crossed collar with a thin silver crane at the edge, under a pale reed-silk cape, the hem tied up in a neat knot for wading and the wide sleeves pushed up. Hands and objects: the right hand rubs one eye; the left lazily holds the handle of a wooden bucket of silver minnows, water splashed over his bare toes; both palms are visibly smooth and soft. Power: none. Background: a blurred grey wooden trough, mist drifting over the water with a few faint motes of dawn light, and a heron standing in the shallows beyond, still as a post. Light: dim blue-grey pre-dawn glow from the upper left, with a soft pale rim on the round cheek. Expression: sleepy and unbothered, a faint contented smile on the stretched face, the peace of someone who has made friends with a smaller life.

people.imagined: Alone at the edge of the grooms' yard, his kit-bag clutched in his lap, someone has said a name too near. He stares back and swears he has not heard.
people.subject: The moment: seated at the edge of the grooms' yard, a battered kit-bag clamped between both arms and knees, he looks at the viewer with careful blank eyes and tight shoulders after someone said a name too near, swearing without a word that he has not heard. Face: a long, narrow, pale face with a high-bridged nose, thin lips pressed together, heavy dark brows, guarded dark eyes with shadows beneath them and a slight clench in the jaw. Hair: black, cropped short, with a tuft standing up at the crown and a few hairs shorn unevenly at the nape. Body: thin and lanky, hunched protectively over the bag. Clothing: neat reed-green silk of a groom with the crossed collar turned up, a thin silver crane at the border, a pale reed-silk cape over it, and a silk rope belt tied in a firm double knot. Hands and objects: both arms wrap a brown leather kit-bag against his chest; at its open top the sharp tip of an old spearhead wrapped in grey cloth shows, clearly visible. Power: a faint cold blue shimmer, like breath on a frosty morning, clings to the bag and his sleeves. Background: a blurred wall of reeds dissolving into dark mist and a dim doorway. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a thin cold rim on his jaw and a deep shadow behind. Expression: a careful, blank, watchful face with the mouth set and the eyes steady, as though he practised the look in a mirror and has not allowed it to slip.

people.imagined: Her first month, holding a bucket she doesn't quite know how to carry, smelling of river pine, blisters on both hands, grinning anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing holding a heavy wooden bucket with both hands, she looks wide-eyed at something large out of frame, then at the viewer with a wide honest grin; it is her first month and she smells of river pine. Face: a round, open, tanned face with a sunburnt nose; big clear hazel eyes; thick light brows; a wide happy mouth; a smudge of mud on the cheek. Hair: brown, in a thick plait down her back tied with a strip of pale green silk, fine curls at the forehead. Body: sturdy, strong-shouldered, short. Clothing: new reed-green silk of a groom, neat and bright, with a crossed collar and a tiny silver crane at the edge; a stiff new pale reed cape with loose ends of reed sticking out; a silk rope belt; the hem tied up and a wet patch on one wide sleeve. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped around the bucket handle, each palm showing a raw red rope blister; the bucket full of silver minnows. Power: none. Background: blurred green reeds in drifting morning mist, with the hint of tall pale cranes and a few motes of light on the water. Light: fresh, luminous dawn spirit-light from the upper left with a soft golden rim on the sunburnt cheek. Expression: honest, delighted, awed; she grins before she knows what she is grinning at, a girl for whom everything is new.

people.imagined: Beside a hurt crane's wing, fresh blood on her apron, a reed splint in her hand, saying something furious about the Pivot out loud.
people.subject: The moment: bent over an injured crane's wing beside a pen, she looks up at the viewer with a fierce scowl, mouth open as if scolding the Pivot out loud. Face: a strong, square, brown face with a stubborn jaw; sharp dark eyes under thick straight brows pulled down; a broad nose; a wide mouth open mid-shout; a faint scar on the chin. Her cheeks are red with temper and a vein shows at her temple. Hair: black, in a low knot, a jade hairpin and a slim reed splint tucked behind each ear, both clearly visible. Body: strong, medium height. Clothing: reed-green silk with a crossed collar and a thin silver crane at the border, a pale reed cape thrown back, and over it a long healer's apron of pale silk streaked with three kinds of stain, old brown, fresh red, and a smear of green medicine paste; the wide sleeves pushed up and tied with cord. Hands and objects: one hand holds a wing of grey and white feathers gently; the other holds a straight reed splint bound with cord. Power: a small soft green healing glow and a few leaf-green motes gather at her fingertips on the wing. Background: a blurred wooden pen veiled in mist, a tall bird's head, straw. Light: warm lantern-like spirit-light from the upper left with a soft rim on the stubborn jaw. Expression: furious and tender at once; her mouth is open for a scolding, and her fingers on the wing are soft.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the moment he shared first breath with a crane, a feather braided into his beard.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; the founder, a lean hawk-catcher, stands face to face with a great crane, forehead nearly touching its beak, eyes closed, at the moment they first shared breath. Face: lean, hard and weathered; a long thin nose; high cheekbones; deep eye creases; closed eyes; a calm mouth; a beard of grey-brown hair with one long white-and-grey crane feather braided into its middle, clearly visible, and two small feathers at its end. Hair: dark brown, tied in a high knot with a leather lace and a plain old silver pin. Body: tall and spare. Clothing: an old-style founder's dress, layered grey and white silk with two crossed collars, wide sleeves, a thick yellowed ruff of crane down on a short mantle, and a hawk-catcher's old dark leather glove with a brass stud on one forearm, the one rough thing he kept. Hands and objects: the gloved hand rests on the long neck of the crane. Power: a faint pale-green breath-mist and slow drifting motes pass between man and bird, the first shared breath, glowing softly. Background: a pale reed marsh in luminous mist and one long grey bird neck, soft. Light: soft gold-silver spirit-light from the upper left, a faint rim along the beard. Expression: peaceful and devout; his closed eyes and slight smile show a quiet joy, with no fear in him.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the rider before her last crossing. A slate-grey riding cap, her crane's neck-ring sewn to her cuff.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a young rider sits upright, steady and brave, looking straight out before her last crossing over a mountain gate; her crane stands beside her, its neck-ring catching the light. Face: a youthful oval face; fair skin; steady dark eyes; straight brows; a small firm mouth; a clear brow. Hair: black, tucked up into a slate-grey silk riding cap with ear flaps tied under her chin with a thin cord, a few strands loose at the cheeks, a small white crane feather pinned at the side. Body: slight, upright. Clothing: close-fitting slate-grey silk riding robes with a crossed collar embroidered with silver cranes, a short collar of white crane down, wide sleeves drawn in at the wrists by pale wrist guards; sewn onto her left cuff, a plain small round brass ring, a crane's neck-ring, very clearly visible. Hands and objects: her left hand held up at the chest to show the cuff ring; her right hand holds a rolled letter sealed with a plain red wax blob, no writing. Power: a faint pale air-green shimmer lifts the edge of her sleeve, soft as a last breath. Background: a pale sky of washed grey mist and one dark bird's wing at the edge. Light: soft pale spirit-light from the upper left, a delicate faded rim along the cheek. Expression: loyal, steady, brave; her gaze is clear and untroubled, a rider who knows the odds and goes.

people.imagined: At night over the vein, a grey-bearded rider reins in his old crane. He lifts his cracked glove for silence. He does not care what the bird thinks of being flown.
people.subject: The moment: at night, riding over the mountain vein, he turns in the saddle on his old reined-in crane and raises a cracked left glove for silence, with a hard stare at the viewer. Face (most important: the cropped grey beard and the scar through the lower lip): a gaunt, hard, dark-tanned face with deep cheek lines, narrow black eyes, a flattened nose and a thin, set mouth split by one scar through the lower lip. Hair: black and grey, cropped short, with a crane quill tucked behind each ear, both visible. Body: broad, squat and rigid in the saddle. Clothing: layered grey silk robes, tar-stained at the hem from the night work, with a crossed collar and a silver crane embroidered at the neck, over which a heavy mantle edged with grey crane down; wrist guards cracked with years of riding, and on the left hand a riding glove whose leather has split across the knuckles; worn but well made, not poverty. Hands and objects: the raised cracked glove with a scarred knuckle showing through the split; the other hand holds black cord reins twisted tight round the fist. Power: a faint cold blue earth-light seeps up from the vein below and runs along the crane's wing and the edge of his mantle. Background: a black night sky veined with mist, the blue glow of a mountain vein below and one large pale wing at the frame edge. Light: cold blue spirit-light from below and the left, with a pale rim on the beard. Expression: hard and impatient, the mouth flat and the stare unsparing; there is no cruelty in the face, only the impatience of a man who does not care what the bird thinks of being flown.

people.imagined: Thigh-deep in the breeding reeds, bent, grunting to a clutch of chicks that answer him. A big grown crane nearby ignores him.
people.subject: The moment: bent and wading thigh-deep in the breeding reeds, he calls with a low grunt to the chicks around him and looks sideways up at the viewer; he has been in the reeds since dawn and the chicks have come to his call while a big grown crane nearby ignores him. Face: a lined old brown face; a long drooping nose; sunken cheeks; small watery brown eyes; sparse white eyebrows; a soft, gentle mouth; a few white whiskers. A fine tremor shakes his chin when he speaks. Hair: thin white hair tied in a wisp at the back, a dry pale reed through it. Body: bent, stooping, thin arms, knotted brown hands. Clothing: a faded but clean and well-made reed-green silk robe with an open crossed collar and a thin silver crane at the border, a pale reed cape tied with soft green grass, the lower robe wet to the thigh; no shoes. Hands and objects: a few small downy grey chicks cluster around his legs; one rests in his cupped hand. Power: a faint pale green-blue water glow and a few drifting motes rise from the reeds around him. Background: blurred reeds, flat silver water under mist, one large crane turning away. Light: soft pearly moonlit mist from the upper left gives his skin a grey-silver sheen, with a thin pale rim on his white hair. Expression: gentle, patient, content; the gentleness in his small wet eyes is like a grandfather's.

people.imagined: In the marsh again, restless at the second bell, one hand clutching her hawk-catcher's glove, looking at the sky where she'd rather be.
people.subject: The moment: standing restlessly in the marsh after the second bell, her gaze flicking from the sky to the viewer and one foot tapping, the reeds walling her in while a thin cloud drifts overhead; she clutches her hawk-catcher's glove. Face: a narrow, sunburnt, lively face with a straight nose, chapped lips, a nick on the chin, quick restless brown eyes and thick straight brows. Hair: dark chestnut in a rough high ponytail tied with silver cord, with a grey crane feather with a black tip tied into it, swinging when she shifts her weight. Body: slim, restless and leaning forward on the balls of her feet. Clothing: fine grey silk with a crossed collar embroidered with a small silver crane, a small scorch mark at one wide cuff, a short mantle of crane down tied with a hawk-catcher's knot, and a silk sash at the waist. Hands and objects: a large, thick, scuffed hawk-catcher's glove on the right hand, held up and clenched, clearly visible. Power: a faint thin gold-grey swirl of air curls round her glove and lifts the feather. Background: blurred reeds swaying behind her under a wide, pale, luminous sky with one thin cloud and a few motes of light. Light: bright cool spirit-light from the upper left with a silver rim on the sunburnt cheek. Expression: restless, eager and impatient; the bright eyes are already somewhere above the marsh and the mouth is pressed in a small tight line, a girl who thinks the marsh is far too small.

people.imagined: Reading a letter aloud to the grooms for a pinch of tea, a satchel strap rubbed thin on his shoulder, dust of the mine in his hair.
people.subject: The moment: reading aloud from a letter held open in front of him and glancing over its top at the viewer with a greedy smile; a groom has paid a pinch of tea and he has begun to read in a loud voice, stressing the exciting parts. Face: a young, long face with a long, prominent, slightly crooked nose (the family nose); sandy-brown skin; bright greedy dark eyes; thick heavy brows; a small pointed chin; a wide grin. Hair: black, spiky, a little dusty, with a small crane feather pinned behind one ear. Body: lean and tall for his age, a bit hunched. Clothing: fine grey silk with a crossed collar and a thin silver crane at the border, a short mantle of crane down, and across the chest a satchel strap of pale silk rubbed thin, almost white at the edge. Hands and objects: both hands hold a sheet of paper open with a few lines of plain scribble, no characters; a small tea pouch in his palm. Power: a faint dusty-gold shimmer drifts off his hair and shoulders. Background: blurred in mist, a half circle of grooms sitting on upturned buckets and a long pale grey roc feather stuck in a post. Light: warm gold spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim on the nose and cheek. Expression: eager, grabby, cheerful.

people.imagined: At a reed grave, leaning on her shovel, mud in her braid, counting in her head. A secret second ledger weighs on her.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a long-handled shovel beside a freshly dug mound in the reeds, she stares evenly at the viewer, having just filled a grave for a crane and laid a long grey wing feather on it, a second hidden tally book tucked in her belt. Face: a plain, strong, earnest face with deep tan skin, wide-set steady dark eyes, heavy straight brows, a broad nose, a stubborn full mouth and a smear of mud on one cheek. Hair: black, in a thick braid with a clump of dried mud caught in it, clearly visible. Body: stocky and strong with sturdy shoulders, standing planted. Clothing: reed-green silk of a groom with a crossed collar and a thin silver crane at the border, the wide sleeves rolled to the elbow and the knees dark with damp earth, and a pale reed cape thrown back over her shoulders; clean for all the digging. Hands and objects: both hands, thick with shovel calluses across each palm, grip the shovel handle; on the small mound at her feet a single long grey wing feather lies laid flat; the small tally book shows at her belt. Power: a faint pale green glow rises from the turned soil like slow breath. Background: blurred tall reeds under a low grey sky, thin mist drifting between them. Light: cold grey-silver spirit-light from the upper left with a faint rim along the cheek. Expression: grave and stubborn, the mouth set and the eyes unblinking, not sad but wholly serious, a labourer's grief held in a face that will not cry.

people.imagined: In the feed boat at dusk, rowing, his face turned up toward a passing crane. The wanting is on his whole face.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a narrow rowing boat at dusk, oars held, his face tilted up toward a passing crane above, mouth slightly open, then his eyes slide to the viewer; the crane's shadow has passed over the boat, he has stopped rowing and the feed sack lies forgotten at his feet. Face: a lean, sharp young face; sun-browned skin; a long nose; wide longing dark eyes; thin brows; chapped lips; fine lines of ambition; a net-scar on the chin; sharp cheekbones and hungry eyes. Hair: black, tied in a short topknot with a string of fine net cord, a small wisp falling over his brow. Body: lean and wiry, rower's shoulders. Clothing: reed-green silk of a groom with a crossed collar and a thin silver crane at the border, a wet pale reed cape on his shoulders, the sleeves rolled, the hem stained with fish scale, a net-cord looped at his belt. Hands and objects: both hands grip the oars, the fingers marked with a crosshatch of thin white net scars, clearly visible. Power: a faint pale-green water-glow shimmers along the oars and the boat's wake. Background: blurred still water mirroring a lilac sunset, reeds, and one tall grey-white crane passing in drifting mist. Light: soft violet-gold spirit-light from the upper left with a warm rim on his tilted face. Expression: longing, ambitious, restless; his mouth is slightly open as if to speak to the passing bird, and he would trade anything for the one thing the crane will not give.

people.imagined: In the marsh hall at the copying desk, holding up inky fingers as she hides a locked chest behind her. The key hangs at her neck.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low copying desk in the marsh hall, she holds up ink-blackened fingers and looks at the viewer guardedly, her body angled to hide a chest; she has copied the flight ledger up to the 790s, the locked chest holds the pages after that, and she has just heard a step in the corridor. Face: a narrow, pale, clever face; a small pointed nose; sharp black eyes; thin pencil brows; a closed thin mouth; black ink speckle on one cheek and a line of ink across her chin where she rested her hand. Hair: black, in a smooth tight knot with a jade-topped bamboo pin. Body: slim, neat, shoulders pulled in. Clothing: neat reed-green silk of a groom with a crossed collar embroidered with a small silver crane and wide sleeves tied back for writing, a pale reed cape folded beside her; at her neck on a silk string hangs one small iron key, in clear view. Hands and objects: the right hand, black to the second knuckle, holds a fine brush; before her a long sheet with neat rows of tiny dark marks, no characters; at the edge of the frame a dark wooden chest with a metal lock. Power: a faint green shimmer lies on the wet ink. Background: a blurred dim hall with drifting lamp-smoke, a shelf of rolled scrolls. Light: warm lamp-glow and silver spirit-light from the upper left with a thin gold rim along the cheek. Expression: guarded, tidy, greedy; a thin tidy smile that does not touch her eyes.
